From 4cf3b6fd54ebb1ebc977bdc47fb6cfcf9a471a22 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Michal Pecio <michal.pecio@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 13:36:42 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] media: uvcvideo: Return queued buffers on start_streaming()
 failure

Return buffers if streaming fails to start due to uvc_pm_get() error.

This bug may be responsible for a warning I got running

    while :; do yavta -c3 /dev/video0; done

on an xHCI controller which failed under this workload.
I had no luck reproducing this warning again to confirm.

xhci_hcd 0000:09:00.0: HC died; cleaning up
usb 13-2: USB disconnect, device number 2
WARNING: CPU: 2 PID: 29386 at drivers/media/common/videobuf2/videobuf2-core.c:1803 vb2_start_streaming+0xac/0x120

Fixes: 7dd56c47784a ("media: uvcvideo: Remove stream->is_streaming field")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Michal Pecio <michal.pecio@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Ricardo Ribalda <ribalda@chromium.org>
Reviewed-by: Laurent Pinchart <laurent.pinchart@ideasonboard.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20251015133642.3dede646.michal.pecio@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Laurent Pinchart <laurent.pinchart@ideasonboard.com>
Signed-off-by: Hans Verkuil <hverkuil+cisco@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/media/usb/uvc/uvc_queue.c b/drivers/media/usb/uvc/uvc_queue.c
index 681a74ed09fb..8b8f44b4a045 100644
--- a/drivers/media/usb/uvc/uvc_queue.c
+++ b/drivers/media/usb/uvc/uvc_queue.c
@@ -177,18 +177,20 @@ static int uvc_start_streaming_video(struct vb2_queue *vq, unsigned int count)
 
 	ret = uvc_pm_get(stream->dev);
 	if (ret)
-		return ret;
+		goto err_buffers;
 
 	queue->buf_used = 0;
 
 	ret = uvc_video_start_streaming(stream);
-	if (ret == 0)
-		return 0;
+	if (ret)
+		goto err_pm;
 
-	uvc_pm_put(stream->dev);
+	return 0;
 
+err_pm:
+	uvc_pm_put(stream->dev);
+err_buffers:
 	uvc_queue_return_buffers(queue, UVC_BUF_STATE_QUEUED);
-
 	return ret;
 }
 
-- 
2.34.1

### Summary of Patch

The patch fixes a bug in the UVC video driver (`uvc_queue.c`) where queued buffers were not returned when streaming failed to start due to a `uvc_pm_get()` error. This caused a kernel warning (`vb2_start_streaming`).

#### Modifications in `drivers/media/usb/uvc/uvc_queue.c`:
- **Error handling restructured**: The original code returned immediately on `uvc_pm_get()` failure without releasing buffers. The new code introduces two `goto` labels (`err_pm` and `err_buffers`) to ensure proper cleanup.
  - On `uvc_pm_get()` failure: jump to `err_buffers` → return all queued buffers via `uvc_queue_return_buffers()`.
  - On `uvc_video_start_streaming()` failure: jump to `err_pm` → call `uvc_pm_put()` first, then fall through to `err_buffers` to return buffers.
- The original successful path now explicitly returns 0 after `uvc_video_start_streaming()` succeeds.

#### Relationships:
- The two error paths are linked: the `err_pm` label handles the case where PM was successfully acquired but streaming fails, so PM must be released before returning buffers.
- The `err_buffers` label is reached either directly from `uvc_pm_get()` failure or after `err_pm` cleanup, ensuring that all queued buffers are always returned on any start_streaming failure. This fixes the bug and prevents the kernel warning.

Here is the commit message:
media: uvcvideo: Return queued buffers on start_streaming()
 failure

Return buffers if streaming fails to start due to uvc_pm_get() error.

This bug may be responsible for a warning I got running

    while :; do yavta -c3 /dev/video0; done

on an xHCI controller which failed under this workload.
I had no luck reproducing this warning again to confirm.

xhci_hcd 0000:09:00.0: HC died; cleaning up
usb 13-2: USB disconnect, device number 2
WARNING: CPU: 2 PID: 29386 at drivers/media/common/videobuf2/videobuf2-core.c:1803 vb2_start_streaming+0xac/0x120

Fixes: 7dd56c47784a ("media: uvcvideo: Remove stream->is_streaming field")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Michal Pecio <michal.pecio@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Ricardo Ribalda <ribalda@chromium.org>
Reviewed-by: Laurent Pinchart <laurent.pinchart@ideasonboard.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20251015133642.3dede646.michal.pecio@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Laurent Pinchart <laurent.pinchart@ideasonboard.com>
Signed-off-by: Hans Verkuil <hverkuil+cisco@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug occurs in `uvc_start_streaming_video()` where, if `uvc_pm_get()` fails, the function returns the error without calling `uvc_queue_return_buffers()` to return the already-queued buffers to the vb2 framework. This violates the vb2 requirement that all buffers must be returned on start_streaming failure, leading to a kernel warning in `vb2_start_streaming()`.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int uvc_start_streaming_video(struct vb2_queue *vq, unsigned int count)
 {
 	struct uvc_video_queue *queue = vb2_get_drv_priv(vq);
 	struct uvc_streaming *stream = uvc_queue_to_stream(queue);
 	int ret;
 
 	lockdep_assert_irqs_enabled();
 
 	ret = uvc_pm_get(stream->dev);
 	if (ret)
-		return ret;
+		goto err_buffers;
 
 	queue->buf_used = 0;
 
 	ret = uvc_video_start_streaming(stream);
-	if (ret == 0)
-		return 0;
+	if (ret)
+		goto err_pm;
 
-	uvc_pm_put(stream->dev);
+	return 0;
 
+err_pm:
+	uvc_pm_put(stream->dev);
+err_buffers:
 	uvc_queue_return_buffers(queue, UVC_BUF_STATE_QUEUED);
-
 	return ret;
 }
